launch_rules: Independently reviewed PR202 execution freeze merged; local manifest byte-equal to committed freeze. No inference before review/merge.
Eight fixed cells in order, one native CLI submission each. Existing outcome/store/input paths block replay. Named single-cell launcher never dispatches the next cell automatically.
Fresh original fixture at one literal owned workspace; same model/settings except existing preset and necessary prompt/schema difference. All budgets unchanged.
All runtime/environment/model/settings/criteria/reference/recipe/first normalized+wire hashes and absent fresh store/input/current root checks before launch.
Stop owned API, unload only evaluation-owned Gemma, archive full tree, bounded diff, grade/regrade and identical guarded GET restart after each cell.
T08 independent original rubric review with reviewer/verdict/criterion/diff hashes required before complete audit and next staging; unknown is not accepted.
Missing/changed input or review receipts, current tree drift or cleanup uncertainty blocks staging, retains remaining rows unrun. No patch repair/rescue/replacement/extra phase.
All eight denominator rows and unknown aggregate usage retained; original cohorts/no-go/8of10 target/G2-G5/defaults unchanged.
